# Hibiscus 0.8.29

This update makes model selection, workspace navigation, and the AI writing
surface clearer and more predictable.

- AI provider settings can now show the complete matching model catalog, and
  model search filters the full catalog so hidden models remain discoverable.
- Control-1 through Control-9 switch directly to the corresponding workspace
  in sidebar order.
- When text is selected in a note, the assistant now shows an explicit preview
  and character count so it is clear that only the selected passage is being
  sent for editing.
- The assistant composer now uses the full input area for typing and focus. Its
  Plus button opens a compact, arrowless action overlay directly above the
  control without moving the conversation.
- Editor AI actions use the same flat, arrowless menu treatment, with cleaner
  row hover behavior.
- Sidebar and editor toolbar icons have consistent hover styling; New Note now
  uses a balanced Plus icon.
- Side panels use a clean white base in light appearance while preserving the
  configured translucency level.
- Toolbar glass is clipped to its controls so it no longer casts a white veil
  across the first line of note text.
